0.reason: continuation_present is a landing guard: reading a plan with a deferred held section as continued errs toward keeping the chain open, which the next landing beat corrects

findings.text: non-blocking: the new clause makes continuation_present true for any plan holding one deferred section under an open decision or gate, without requiring that section to be the only remaining work, so a landing that resolves the driver followup while other sections are still open is accepted with no next step — a case the guard refused before this change and that section 8's motivating case does not cover.

non-blocking: the guard's decision-open test (no choice recorded) disagrees with reckon/roadmap.py:1115, which labels a rationale-bearing unchosen decision as deferred and drops it from the unsettled set, so a decision the guard treats as holding a plan can read as invisible on the surface the lead's accept condition relies on; the gate-closed test at reckon/_store.py:3963 likewise duplicates reckon/roadmap.py:949 rather than reusing it.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against 7b529f43888a288a60f6c9a84c63576e81b2bf4a; the production change is one clause in continuation_present at reckon/_store.py:3979-3983 plus three private helpers at reckon/_store.py:3903-3967, with its test file, one skill paragraph and the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the plan's done-when names tests/test_a_waiting_plan_needs_no_placeholder.py with a locked-decision negative control; that file is at the reviewed head and the manifest records its run alongside the base and negative-control arms.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a plan whose remaining work is a deferred section held by an open decision or an open gate lands with no placeholder followup; reckon/_store.py:3983 adds that clause to continuation_present and the added test lands such a plan successfully with no followup appended.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at its run directory; it records status complete, base 2 failed/3 passed EXIT=1, head 5 passed EXIT=0, negative control 1 failed/4 passed EXIT=1, naming all three log paths.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the diff touches reckon/_store.py, skills/reckon-edit/SKILL.md, tests/test_a_waiting_plan_needs_no_placeholder.py and the landing fragment, every one of them inside the node's declared write paths.

justifications.durability: gate-base.log shows tests/test_a_waiting_plan_needs_no_placeholder.py:145 and :179 failing on CONTINUATION_REQUIRED when the clause is absent, so the added assertions would redden on the regression, and none of them compares a value against an input the test itself supplied.
justifications.evidence: baseline_suite and after_suite in the manifest carry the same literal pytest command with EXIT=1 and EXIT=0, and gate-base.log and gate-head.log each name their revision and end in a bare EXIT line.
justifications.fit: the three helpers at reckon/_store.py:3903-3967 sit beside continuation_present, are named by mechanism, and their docstrings state the rule rather than a plan label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_store.py:3983 makes continuation_present accept a deferred section held by an open decision or gate, which is the deliverable the plan's section 8 states.
